physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Read context/baseline.json, context/protocol.json, and the complete immutable feedback artifact artifact-4a1b4b8428d74453a4fc776a21cdb360, including build/evaluation/report.json at commit 7a85d34af02b69c6f2d5628c6eb52c53d1841042. Its history contains baseline (40,0.55,0,0) and candidate 1 (40,0.55,1,0); the proposed (40,0.55,1,10) is untried and within the frozen domain. Candidate 1 reduced cell area from 161954 to 157315 um2 (2.86%) and reported setup/hold slack of 0.423833/0.0655785 ns, but failed electrical qualification with 12 max_slew and 5 max_cap violations, zero max_fanout violations, and no measured workload energy. The qualified baseline remains the only rank-eligible result, with score 1.0 and no electrical violations. Retain utilization, density, and ABC area optimization to pursue the observed cell-area saving; increase repair_margin from 0 to 10 as the smallest positive allowed setting to target the observed electrical failure while limiting potential repair area and energy overhead. This is an engineering hypothesis: the reports give violation counts, not severities or evidence that margin 10 will suffice. Holding placement settings isolates this repair change. The objective uses cell area times geometric-mean normalized DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energy, so neither smaller die area nor candidate 1 area alone establishes a score improvement. Repair may consume its area saving or reduce hold slack; qualification and workload energy require independent evaluation. No candidate energy, qualification, or improved score is claimed. Energy comparisons retain the baseline Liberty-model, zero-delay gate-activity and extracted-SPEF scope. RTL, clock period 10526 ps, libraries, and acceptance thresholds remain frozen; no EDA, screening search, model, or agent was run. Local schema, domain, and captured-history uniqueness checks passed. The required validator could not execute because tools/run_ppa.py could not import run_ppa_workflow_study; the gate remains unverified, as recorded in build/proposal_validation.json.
